# Creative Store (United States)

> > Creative Store offers premium audio products including Sound Blaster sound cards, SXFI spatial audio technology, speakers, headphones, and webcams for gaming, music, and professional use.

Creative Labs operates us.creative.com as the official US e-commerce and product information hub for their audio equipment brand. The site features product catalogs, shopping functionality, and support resources for consumers seeking gaming audio, hi-res audio, and work-from-home solutions.

## Key Topics

- Sound Blaster
- SXFI (Super X-Fi)
- Hi-Res Audio
- Gaming Audio
- Bluetooth Audio
- USB Audio Devices
- Desktop Speakers
- Headphones & Earbuds
- Audio DAC/Amplifiers
- Webcams
- Spatial Audio Holography
- aptX Lossless
- RGB Gaming Products
- Audio Accessories
- Work-from-Home Solutions

## Shopping & Account

- [Shopping Cart](https://us.creative.com/shoppingcart): Shopping cart and checkout for Sound Blaster, SXFI, and audio products
- [Sign In / Register Account](https://us.creative.com/account): User account sign-in and registration page for Creative Store

## Featured Technologies & Collections

- [Super X-Fi Personalized Audio Holography](https://us.creative.com/sxfi): Super X-Fi spatial audio holography technology for immersive headphone experience
- [Audio Enthusiasts](https://us.creative.com/p/audio-enthusiasts): Premium audio products for music, gaming, movies, and audio enthusiasts
- [Hybrid-friendly Audio Essentials for Workspaces](https://us.creative.com/wfh): Work-from-home audio solutions: webcams, headphones, microphones, DAC/amp

- [Sound Blaster - Product Overview](https://us.creative.com/p/sound-blaster): Sound Blaster product line including DAC, amp, and sound cards for gaming
